question: I'm a CS senior with a Business Administration minor. I've taken over 49 courses. How do I know if my BA minor requirements are fully satisfied before my final semester?
expected_answer: P-007 should verify through Stellic (unofficial) or S3 (official) whether all BA minor required courses have been completed with passing grades. The typical BA minor requires a set of core BA courses. Since P-007 is a CS student with BA minor and has taken 49 courses, they should check the official BA minor requirements checklist. The advisor should confirm no courses were taken P/N that might not count toward the minor.
reasoning_type: Minor completion verification — identification of what remains
common_mistake: Assuming course count (49 courses) implies minor completion; not checking if any relevant courses were elected P/N (which would not satisfy minor requirements)
needs_verification: Retrieve the full list of P-007's completed courses to map against BA minor requirements
Confirm exact BA minor requirements (specific required courses and unit minimums)
Confirm whether any P-007 courses were taken P/N that might affect minor requirement satisfaction
Confirm P-007's Stellic audit reflects the current BA minor catalog year
